_comment: Public SDSU and crisis resources served by GET /api/v1/resources. Load with `flask --app wsgi seed-resources --replace`. Check each source_url before a demo and update verified_on.

resources.name: Emergency Services (911)
resources.description: Immediate danger, fire, or a medical emergency. This app does not replace 911.

resources.name: SDSU University Police Department
resources.description: Campus police and communications center, staffed 24/7 including holidays. Dial 111 from a campus phone.

resources.name: UPD Safety Escort
resources.description: Free 24/7 escort to or from your car, residence hall, the library, or anywhere on or next to campus.

resources.name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
resources.description: Free, confidential support for anyone in emotional distress. Call, text, or chat.

resources.name: After-hours on-call counselor (via UPD)
resources.description: During the academic year, University Police can reach an on-call SDSU counselor after hours.

resources.name: SDSU Counseling Services
resources.description: Free counseling for SDSU students at the Miller Wellness Center. Walk-in screenings Monday to Friday, 8:30 to 11 a.m. and 12:30 to 3 p.m.

resources.name: SDSU Student Health Clinic
resources.description: Student health clinic at 1440 North Campus Dr. Call and select option 3 for appointments. Monday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Tuesday to Friday 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

resources.name: Brookings Health System Emergency Department
resources.description: Hospital emergency department at 300 22nd Ave. S., open 24/7.

resources.name: Housing and Residential Life
resources.description: Residence hall questions and maintenance concerns during business hours. Routine work orders go through the University Housing Portal on MyState.

resources.name: Facilities and Services Front Desk
resources.description: Campus building maintenance. Submit an online work request or call the front desk.

resources.name: Brookings Police Department (non-emergency)
resources.description: City police non-emergency line for off-campus concerns.
